SERVICES

Esso

View in App

Enjoy more with Kris+ now! You can now earn KrisPay miles when you pay with Kris+ at Esso for fuel and diesel purchases.
 

Esso operates an extensive network of service stations that offer motorists their improved Synergy petrol as well as good value and convenience.


Terms & Conditions:

  • Payment must be made at the cashier’s counter in the service station.
  • Kris+ transactions can be used at Esso Service Stations in Singapore only for petrol and diesel to the value indicated.
  • Up to 12% upfront fuel discount will apply in place of all other existing card discounts at Esso Singapore Stations.    
  • Any KrisPay Miles earned from using the Kris+ app for payment at Esso Singapore Stations shall be in addition to your bank card’s rewards (where applicable), subject to individual bank card’s terms and conditions and Esso’s Terms and Conditions. 
  • For the avoidance of doubt, Esso specific bank and card discounts, promotions, vouchers, cash rebates and other similar promotions are not eligible with and will not apply to payments made through the Kris+ app at Esso Singapore Stations. 
  • Any claims, issues or disputes relating to Kris+ payments at Esso Singapore Stations shall be referred directly to Aster Mobility Solutions 1 Pte. Ltd. (“AMS1”) for decision, whose decision shall be final and binding on the user. 
  • AMS1 reserves the right to terminate, suspend or vary any offers, terms, conditions, programmes (including this programme itself), promotions or discount(s) stipulated herein or otherwise without prior notification.
